parameters.query:
-- 0039: the agency's name and Elliot address (or its own domain) and where replies go.
select email_sender(nullif($1, '')::uuid, $2) as sender;

nodes.name: Send via Resend
nodes.notes: Credential: Resend API key (Header Auth: Authorization = Bearer re_...).

nodes.name: Send via Gmail (team fallback)
nodes.notes: Only for emails to the agency's own team, if Resend is down. Clients never get an email from this Gmail.

meta.description: Every email Elliot sends for an agency (0039): via Resend, from the agency's name and Elliot address.
